Notes
1) The above unaudited standalone financial results of the Company have been prepared in accordance with Indian Accounting Standards ("Ind AS") prescribed under Section 133 of the Companies Act, 2013 ('the Act') read with the relevant rules thereunder and in terms of Regulation 33 of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, as amended.
2) The above unaudited standalone financial results of the Company were reviewed by the Audit Committee and taken on record by the Board of Directors of the Company at their respective meetings held on November 12, 2026. The statutory auditors have expressed an unmodified review conclusion on these results.
3) Operating segments are reported in a manner consistent with the internal reporting provided to the chief operating decision-maker. The Whole Time Director and Chief Executive Officer who is responsible for allocating resources and assessing performance of the operating segments, has been identified as the chief operating decision-maker. From the internal organisation of the Company’s activities and consistent with the internal reporting provided to the chief operating decision-maker and after considering the nature of its services, the ultimate customer availing those services and the methods used by it to provide those services, “Hotel Services” has been identified to be the Group’s sole operating segment.
4) Current Status of Business Operations and Ability to Continuity as Going Concern
The Company has earned profit (before exceptional items and tax) of INR 437.72 lakhs during the quarter ended 30 September 2026 and incurred loss of INR 35.38 lakhs during year to date ended 30 September 2026. However, The current liabilities exceed the current assets as of 30 September 2026. Notwithstanding this, the financial results have been prepared on a going concern basis, considering the significant improvement in operating performance, which is expected to be further supported by several cost-reduction measures being adopted by the Company.

5) On November 21, 2025, the Government of India notified four Labour Codes, effective immediately: the Code on Wages, 2019; the Industrial Relations Code, 2020; the Code on Social Security, 2020; and the Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code, 2020 (together, the "New Labour Codes"). These Codes replace 29 existing labour laws. The Ministry of Labour and Employment also published FAQs to help companies assess the financial impact of the changes.
During the six months ended 30 September 2026, the Government of India notified the final Central Rules under the Labour Codes. Accordingly, the Company has assessed the financial impact of the New Labour Codes, read together with the final Central Rules, on its employee benefit obligations. Based on management’s assessment and actuarial valuation, in accordance with the applicable accounting requirements and guidance issued by the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India, the Company has recognised an incremental employee benefit liability of INR 448.97 lakhs, representing past service cost. This one-time past service cost has been recognised as an exceptional item in the standalone financial results for the quarter and six months ended 30 September 2026.
The Company continues to monitor the finalisation of the State Rules by the Government of the National Capital Territory of Delhi and any further clarifications issued by the Government of India regarding the implementation of the New Labour Codes. The consequential financial impact, if any, arising from such developments will be recognised in the period in which the relevant requirements become applicable and their impact can be reliably determined.

6) During the quarter ended 30 September 2026, the Company deposited Rs.159.66 crores with the Registrar General of the Hon’ble High Court of Delhi. The deposit was made in compliance with the Court’s order dated 03 August 2026 in CS(COMM) 376/2026, under which DBS Bank India Limited was directed to release to the Company the original title deeds of its hotel property, Hyatt Regency, Bhikaji Cama Place, New Delhi. In that order, the Court found a strong prima facie case in the Company’s favour. Following the deposit, DBS Bank India Limited has released the title deeds to the Company. Based on legal advice, management is confident of a favourable outcome, and the deposit is shown under Other financial assets.

7) 'Figures of previous reporting periods have been regrouped/ reclassified wherever necessary to correspond with the figures of the current reporting period.
